Google BigQuery

A common foundation for commercial reporting.

GBOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Combine approved business data in BigQuery's managed analytics platform and query it through defined data models. MoreSpace can build advertising-to-CRM reporting, event analysis, and revenue marts that give teams a consistent view of performance. We agree on identifiers, reporting dates, cost allocation, and metric definitions before joining sources so dashboards answer the same business question across channels and departments.

Useful outputs

  • Curated commercial reporting tables
  • Reconciled channel and cohort measures
  • Source freshness and quality reports

Where we can apply it

  • Ad spend and CRM outcomes → modeled joins → reconciliation → acquisition dashboard.
  • Website events → curated cohorts → metric validation → conversion-analysis workspace.
  • Sales and finance exports → governed revenue mart → BI report → management review.

Inputs we need

  • Authorized advertising and CRM exports
  • Event data and identity mappings
  • Agreed metric and date definitions

Delivery sequence

  • Define source access, identifiers, regions, and reporting conventions.
  • Load and model data with validation and controlled access.
  • Reconcile samples against source systems before publishing dashboards.

Expert review points

  • Check joins and deduplication so leads or revenue are not counted twice.
  • Inspect query costs, permissions, and refresh behavior as data grows.
